links.outcome: Proportion of hospital online labour epidural materials meeting sixth-grade readability target
links.effect: 14.5% and 23.2% of texts met target readability on two commonly used scores; mean grade 8.4 ± 2.1 did not meet target.
links.quote: Online patient-information on labour epidural analgesia frequently exceeds the recommended sixth grade reading level.

links.outcome: Readability of patient education texts after ChatGPT rewriting to sixth-grade level
links.effect: After AI-modification, 24.6% and 27.5% met targets; mean grade fell from 8.4 to 7.7 (P<0.001) but still missed the target level.
links.quote: ChatGPT can be used to enhance readability but also fails to meet recommended health literacy standards.

links.effect: 24.6% and 27.5% met targets; mean grade 7.7 ± 1.2 (P <0.001), still not target.
links.quote: After AI-modification, 24.6% and 27.5% of the texts met targets using the same metrics, with the mean grade (7.7 ± 1.2) decreasing significantly (P <0.001), but still not meeting the target level.
